title: Hapbeat Scene viewer-edits.json
description: What a person changed on single firings in Hapbeat Studio's Scene tab, kept apart from the recording (<project>/Saved/HapticViewer/viewer-edits.json, specs/scene-recording.md section 3.5). Players lay it over viewer-data.json; the recording is never rewritten.

of.description: The recorded firing: its name, time and hand as viewer-data.json has them (matched within half a frame).

gain.description: Used instead of the recorded events[].gain.

t.description: Used instead of the recorded events[].t (seconds). frames / fps at most, checked by readers.
